shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml && command -v lore-query-trace || true && rg -n \"chatOrchestrator|tool_result|Unknown tool|function-valued|compiled once\" src/orchestration -g '*.test.ts'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,180p' package.json && rg -n \"specs/.*#|validated by\" src -g '*.test.ts' | head -40 && rg -n \"reanchor\" scripts package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix registry test mock assertions" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
